10k.note: 10-K fetched (bax_10k_full.htm) but the parser found no R&D / pipeline section heading — Baxter is a medical-products and hospital-supplies company (IV therapies, infusion systems, surgical, advanced surgery, pharmaceuticals). It markets approved products rather than running a drug discovery pipeline; following the 2024 Vantive (kidney care) divestiture the remaining business is chiefly devices and approved injectables.

website.error: no public drug pipeline page — Baxter publishes product portfolios (Medical Products & Therapies, Healthcare Systems & Technologies, Pharmaceuticals) but not a clinical-stage pipeline.

ctgov.note: All 30 Baxter-led studies are COMPLETED (29) or WITHDRAWN (1). The remaining 62 hits are investigator-initiated or other-sponsor trials that merely list a Baxter affiliate as collaborator. No active P1/P2/P3 trial is sponsored by Baxter.

commercial_product.note: Baxter sells approved hospital products: PD/HD dialysis solutions and devices (legacy, partly divested to Vantive 2024), Spectrum IQ infusion pumps, Hillrom hospital beds and connected-care platforms, parenteral nutrition (Clinimix, Clinolipid), inhaled anesthetics (Suprane, Brevibloc), generic injectables, hemostats and sealants (Floseal, Tisseel, Hemopatch). These are marketed products, not clinical-stage pipeline assets.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: All 30 Baxter-sponsored ctgov studies are COMPLETED or WITHDRAWN; not enumerated individually.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: 62 ctgov hits with Baxter as collaborator only (lead sponsor is an academic center or other pharma); not proprietary.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Adjacent medtech / hospital-products company with no active proprietary P1/P2/P3 clinical trials in the public registry as of snapshot. Baxter's R&D output is incremental device and approved-injectable line extensions, not investigational new molecular entities.
